caseNameFull: Edward H. Chavelle, as Trustee, etc. v. Washington Trust Company
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court' of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. E. C. Hughes for appellant. Mr. James B. Murphy for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 4 of the Act of January 28, 1915, c. 22, 38 Stat. 803, 804. See also Schmitt v. Shadrach, ante, p. 538.
